claims.claim_text: NifBuilder is a copy-on-write mutable builder. Copying a NifBuilder shares the underlying payload until the next mutation detaches it.
NifCursor is an owned read handle into a frozen NIF tree. Copying a NifCursor creates another read handle to the same underlying tree snapshot.
snapshot(tree) requires a non-empty tree and takes var NifBuilder (borrows, does not consume).
isEmpty(tree) is the guard before snapshot(tree).

createTree() starts empty output. createTree(kind; children...) and createTree(kind, info; children...) build a validated node where kind is an enum (NimonyStmt/NimonyExpr/NimonyType/NimonyOther/NimonyPragma).
createTree(kind, children...) validates the node shape.
withTree(kind, info) emits a balanced node: opens tag, runs body, closes tag. kind is an enum type.
kind and info tell you the raw token kind and source location on a NifCursor.
stmtKind, exprKind, typeKind, otherKind, pragmaKind return the plugin-level node category.
skip(node) skips the whole current subtree. firstChild(n) + hasMore provides bounded iteration over children.
takeTree(t, var node) copies the current subtree and advances the reader. addSubtree(t, node) copies without advancing.
add(t, childTree) appends another whole NifBuilder.
addDotToken emits a dot placeholder. addStrLit, addIntLit, addUIntLit, addIdent, addCharLit, addFloatLit emit literal atoms.
addSymUse(symId|string, info) emits a symbol-use token.
addEmptyNode, addEmptyNode2, addEmptyNode3, addEmptyNode4 emit one to four dot placeholders. All accept an optional info: LineInfo parameter.
renderTree(tree) renders raw NIF text for debugging (omits line info). renderNode(node) renders the current subtree (omits line info).
isValid(info) checks whether source info exists. filePath(info) returns the source path. lineCol(info) returns SourcePos with 1-based line and col.
claims.evaluation_notes: DETERMINISTIC. Covers invalid NoLineInfo in the existing node I/O test and real call-site line info in test_c17_real_line_info.nim.

claims.claim_text: errorTree(msg) builds a synthetic error node. errorTree(msg, info) uses info for location. errorTree(msg, at) uses at NifCursor for location. errorTree(msg, at, orig) uses at for location and orig as embedded source.
eqIdent(name) is the quick exact-name check for identifiers and symbols.
symId, symText, identText, stringValue, charLit, intValue, uintValue, floatValue read the payload of the current token.
tagId, tagText, tag are for raw tag inspection when you need exact NIF shape.
Copying a NifBuilder does not mean shared mutation; later writes detach.
Do not snapshot an empty tree.
Do not assume a copied NifBuilder sees later mutations performed through another copy.
Do not use inc on a NifCursor — inc does not exist for NifCursor. Use skip for subtrees, takeTree for atoms, or firstChild+hasMore for iteration.
claims.evaluation_notes: inc does not exist on NifCursor in the current API.

claims.claim_text: Use NoLineInfo only for genuinely synthetic structure. Preserve source info from existing nodes when output is derived from them.
loadPluginInput() reads paramStr(1) by default and returns the input root as NifCursor. saveTree(tree) writes to paramStr(2) preserving line info.
claims.evaluation_notes: NUANCED. The explicit filename round-trip is verified directly.

claims.claim_text: NifCursor keeps the backing tree alive for you.
Emit balanced trees. Match the expected child categories for the tag you are constructing.
First step: resolve nimony executable with readlink -f $(command -v nimony), then open ../src/nimony/lib/plugins.nim relative to it.
A real end-to-end Nimony plugin is exposed through a user-facing template ... {.plugin: "name".} entrypoint, with the rewrite logic living in a separate plugin module.
The default loadPluginInput() and saveTree() overloads work end-to-end under real plugin execution driven by nimony.
For new compile-time DSL rewrites in Nimony, expose a plugin-backed template ... {.plugin: "name".} entrypoint rather than writing a Nim macro.
There are four plugin kinds: template plugin, module plugin, type plugin, and import plugin.
Plugins are compiled with Nimony itself. The compiler invokes a separate nimony c invocation per plugin and caches the result.
The plugin path in {.plugin: "path".} is relative to the directory of the source file containing the pragma string literal, not the call site.
A template plugin input NifCursor is wrapped in a StmtsS node. Use firstChild(n) to skip past this wrapper.
claims.evaluation_notes: DETERMINISTIC. End-to-end template plugin fixture verifies StmtsS root and first argument access.

claims.claim_text: A type plugin receives two inputs: paramStr(1) is the module AST, and paramStr(3) is the type definition(s).
Plugins are deterministic: same input produces same output. The compiler caches results.
Template plugins can be hidden inside imported modules so callers don't see the .plugin pragma.
A module plugin receives the entire module after semantic analysis and must output back the complete module.
createTree(kind, children) produces validated trees; withTree output is NOT validated.
The import module is `plugins` (import plugins), not nimonyplugins. The source file is `src/nimony/lib/plugins.nim`.
bindSym(name, rule=brClosed) emits a hygienic symbol reference resolved at plugin definition scope. Emits a fully-qualified Symbol, not a bare Ident.
claims.evaluation_notes: DETERMINISTIC. bindSym emits a Symbol with module-qualified name.

claims.claim_text: firstChild(n) returns a bounded cursor at the first child of a ParLe node, usable with hasMore for safe iteration.
hasMore(n) returns true while there are more children before the closing ). Works with bounded cursors from firstChild.
into n: body enters the current node, runs body to process children, then advances past the closing ). loopInto n: body enters and iterates all children.
claims.evaluation_notes: DETERMINISTIC. loopInto requires body to advance n (e.g. skip n).

claims.claim_text: copyInto(t, var node): body copies the opening tag into t, runs body for children, closes the node, and advances node past the matching ).
balancedTokens n: body deep-scans all compound (ParLe) nodes inside the subtree rooted at n. body must not advance n. Does not include the root node itself.
The Replacer type bundles NifCursor+ NifBuilder with balanced operations: keep (copy+assert), drop (skip+assert), keepTag (descend into node), loopKeepTag (descend+iterate).
loadReplacer() reads input and returns a Replacer. saveReplacer(r) writes output to paramStr(2). Round-trips through .nif files.
Replacer keep/drop/replace require a kind annotation: Any, Expr, Type, Stmt, Sym, Dot, Lit, Nested, Def, or a concrete enum tag.
claims.evaluation_notes: Kind annotations use ChildKind enum or concrete tag enums. Factual.

claims.claim_text: renderTree omits line info for debugging. saveTree preserves line info for .nif output.
SymId and TagId are opaque handle types. SymId has == and $ operators. TagId has $ for textual rendering.
lineCol(info) returns a SourcePos object with line and col fields (1-based integers, or 0 when invalid).
getCursor(r) returns a copy of the Replacer's current cursor. setCursor(r, c) restores it. peek r: body saves cursor, runs body, restores cursor.
replaceHead(t, tag, info): body replaces the opening tag of the current node, keeping children processed via body.

A plugin-backed varargs template can use Replacer to rewrite a call into a runtime sink call, preserve ordinary helper-call arguments, replace selected marker calls, drop selected marker calls, and append a synthetic policy argument.
claims.evaluation_notes: DETERMINISTIC. The privacy-audit example compiles and verifies redaction, dropping, preservation, and appended policy output.

claims.claim_text: Replacer leaf operations assert the expected kind against the current cursor; calling keep r, Expr at a StmtsS root exits with an assertion failure instead of skipping to an expression.
A keepTag body must consume every child of the current node; leaving a child unconsumed exits with a body-must-consume-all-children assertion failure.
peek r: body restores the Replacer source cursor but does not roll back mutations to r.dest; output emitted inside peek persists.

changelog.action: Major API update for latest Nimony plugins. Import module changed from nimonyplugins to plugins. Renamed types to NifBuilder/NifCursor. Removed ~/%~/nifFragment template DSL, inc on NifCursor. Added Replacer API, bindSym, firstChild/hasMore/into/loopInto/balancedTokens traversal, copyInto, SourcePos/SymId/TagId types, import plugins, Nimony self-compilation. All 43 testable claims pass.
Refinement pass: added real call-site line info coverage for C17 and removed the recorded source line-info coverage gap.
Refinement pass: verified template plugin root shape and Replacer misuse contracts for the Replacer API reference rewrite.
